title: STAR Arts — AR Constellation Gallery
description: Augmented-reality constellation experiences. Open on a phone (iPhone or Android) and allow the camera.

constellations.name: Orion
constellations.description: Place the Hunter's constellation on a wall, tap the stars for their physical data, toggle 2D/3D depth, and take the sourced Lore journey through its brightest stars.

constellations.name: Andromeda
constellations.description: The chained princess, running east from the Great Square of Pegasus. Her lore journey ends at the Little Cloud — the smudge al-Sufi recorded in 964 CE that turned out to be another galaxy.
